payload.title: Re-export extension-author types from the package index
payload.description:
Three Zavro files reverse-engineer Frick's own extension types from the ServerOptions surface because they aren't exported:
- PolicyHook  → NonNullable<ServerOptions["policyHooks"]>[number]  (apps/backend/src/runtime/automation.ts:51)
- FrickProjection → NonNullable<ServerOptions["projections"]>[number] + the apply ctx type (apps/backend/src/projections/index.ts:18)
- FrickBlobProcessor → NonNullable<ServerOptions["blobProcessors"]>[number] (apps/backend/src/domains/media/processor.ts:20)
Also the FrickPolicyInput shape and FrickAppRoute handler arg types. Just export these from @fricken/server's index so app authors stop deriving them. Pure packaging change, no behavior. Pairs with the router kit.
